integrity: The claim is proved by an explicit four-case construction and four forced-edge obstructions. Small cases were independently exhaustively checked; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to acyclic orientations of \(K_{3,n}\) with \(n\ge4\); it does not classify \(K_{m,n}\) for \(m\ge4\) or mixed partial orientations. Finite verification supports but does not replace the general proof.
title: Exact non-separating out-branchings in acyclic orientations of \(K_{3,n}\)
